sources.supportingExcerpt: grant visas type (Visit) to the holders of Malaysian passports at points of entry (Airports, and Land)

policies.title: Malaysian ordinary passports: Iraq visit visa at entry points
policies.summary: Iraq's Kuala Lumpur Embassy announces that holders of Malaysian passports receive visit visas at Iraqi air and land entry points, effective 11 September 2024.
conditions: Ordinary Malaysian-passport visitor baseline under the Iraqi Embassy's nationality-specific announcement; the visit visa is issued at an Iraqi airport or land point of entry.
The announcement does not establish duration, fee, work, residence, special-document, transit, Iraqi-origin, carrier or final-admission treatment.

conflicts.explanation: Iraq's Ministry of Foreign Affairs Embassy in Kuala Lumpur expressly says Malaysian-passport holders receive visit visas at Iraqi air and land points of entry, effective 11 September 2024. That is border issuance, not visa-free entry.
